description: Simple Type1 font whose /Encoding dictionary carries a /Differences array remapping code points to named glyphs including accented Latin letters (egrave, eacute, odieresis, udieresis) — see the font dictionary's raw /Differences array. The rendered text on this particular page happens to be plain ASCII (it targets a pdf.js word-spacing bug, 'Words that should have spaces between them'), so this fixture's ground-truth value primarily protects against word-assembly space-collapsing regressions, while its /Differences-bearing font dictionary still exercises EncodingResolver's /Differences-array code path structurally.

oracle.method: poppler pdftotext (independent third-party extractor, never PlumePdf); /Differences array confirmed via `strings issue4304.pdf | grep Differences`.

pages.expectedText: Words that should have spaces between them.
